regions.region: upper-left continuation of the 4a elimination section
regions.finding: Only analytical characterization of 4a continues from page 6; it was linked to the existing 2a-to-4a TBAF elimination record and not counted as a new experiment.
The Scheme 2 experiment was enriched with exact substrate, TBAF/THF solution, DMF, time, isolated masses/yields for (Z)-2n and 4n, and chromatography conditions.

The existing Scheme 3 Sonogashira record was enriched with all stated reagent quantities, sequential addition, room-temperature duration, TLC completion, purification, product mass, and isolated yield.

regions.region: bottom-left through upper-right, Suzuki procedure for 6a
regions.finding: The cross-column 6a procedure was read as one experiment and enriched with two distinct dioxane additions, explicit nitrogen handling, 110 °C/48 h heating, workup, purification, product mass, and isolated yield.

The 7a Scheme 3 record was enriched with its explicitly restated quantities, 110 °C/6 h conditions, chromatography, product mass, and isolated yield; atmosphere and workup were left missing rather than inherited from 6a.

regions.region: right-column Supporting Information statement, acknowledgments, and references 1-3
regions.finding: No additional independent experimental record is stated. The acknowledgment that selected scope results were reproduced supplies no separate batch conditions or outcomes. SI is mentioned but no SI file was provided or associated.

unresolved: Scheme 3 and the detailed procedure disagree on the 4a elimination temperature (30 °C versus room temperature).
NOE-based stereochemical support and the stated NMR spectra are in unavailable Supporting Information.

regions.region: entire page, references 4-17 and publication dates
regions.finding: The page contains only bibliographic citations to prior literature and article dates; there are no current-paper arrows, tables, footnotes, procedures, or independent experiments to extract.

unresolved: Cited prior-literature reactions were not converted into experiments of the current paper.
